messages:
Mira Patel: Quick heads-up — I started a canary for q4b-qa-small on staging with a small promptset (1k). Seeing weird regressions on extractive QA where answers get truncated.
Sam O'Connor: can you paste an example?
Mira Patel: sure — prompt id p_9421: model returns partial sentence twice, e.g. 'The cause was' then cuts. Also tokenization looks off for apostrophes.
Jorge Alvarez: could be tokenizer mismatch after quant conversion. Which tokenizer/shim was used on the compile job?
Mira Patel: used tokenizer v2 + bytefallback shim per the q4b compile notes.
Keiko Tanaka: label ops FYI — we might need to freeze a mini-golden subset and re-label a few samples if this is stable. How many failing examples?
Mira Patel: ~18/1k showing truncation or malformed spans. 7 are high-priority QA anchors.
Sam O'Connor: can we diff logits? run a quick compare between fp16 baseline and q4b on the same prompt and beam. I can drop a script.
Sam O'Connor: ```python
# quick compare
from redwood_eval import Runner
br = Runner(model="fp16-baseline")
br_q = Runner(model="q4b-qa-small")
print(br.run("p_9421"))
print(br_q.run("p_9421"))
```
Jorge Alvarez: also check KV cache alignment. Quant kernels sometimes reorder positional ops causing early EOS tokens in longctx.
Keiko Tanaka: label-bot — can you queue those 7 anchors for manual review with priority tag "q4b-canary"?
label-bot: queued 7 items to /labeler/priority/q4b-canary (ETA 6h).
Mira Patel: thanks. I also noticed embedding-based dedupe is flagging duplicates inconsistently across models — the embed space changed after quantization. Two nearly identical prompts are no longer neighbors.
Jorge Alvarez: that could be numeric jitter from quantized weights. For dedupe we should compare both l2 and cosine and use a higher recall threshold for quant models.
Sam O'Connor: propose plan: 1) collect failing ids, 2) run fp16 vs q4b diffs, 3) freeze mini-golden (50 examples), 4) send to label ops for adjudication, 5) run a canary traffic split 2% with automatic fallback to fp16 on regression >5%.
Keiko Tanaka: sounds good. I can provision labeler capacity — will need tagging schema: reason, failure-type (truncation/tokenization/answer-mismatch), preferred-correct-answer, comments.
Mira Patel: adding triage checklist in the thread: 
- reproduce example locally
- attach model outputs + tokenized tokens
- run embedding nearest neighbor check
- re-run quant compile with alternative kernel set if needed

Jorge Alvarez: add a quick command for canary rollout (ops):
```bash
# canary rollout 2% to q4b-qa-small
redwoodctl deploy --model q4b-qa-small --route /qa --traffic 2% --fallback fp16-baseline
```
OpsBot: deploy request received for q4b-qa-small to /qa at 2% traffic; will alert on error-rate >1.5%.
Sam O'Connor: timeline: I'll run diffs today, Jorge can try alternate kernel compile tomorrow if diffs point to KV/pos issues. Keiko will start relabeling once label-bot finishes queueing.
Keiko Tanaka: labelers assigned, ETA ~8h for first pass. Will surface borderline cases.
Mira Patel: thanks — once label adjudication is in, we should update the golden set and re-run the full q4b eval harness (regression + latency + token-accuracy). If passes, we can widen to 10%.
Jorge Alvarez: note — if embedding dedupe drifts, we should add cross-model dedupe step: compute duplicates under both fp16 and q4b, union them for golden freeze, avoid losing recall.
Sam O'Connor: +1. I'll add that to the eval job: --dedupe-mode union-fp16-q4b.
Mira Patel: final ask — can someone log the candidate diffs to the runbook issue? I'll open the issue and link in this thread.
Keiko Tanaka: I'll keep this thread updated with label status and key adjudications. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: opening issue now — https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood-inference/ops/issues/2312 (linked) 
Mira Patel: thanks all, syncing again after label pass and diff artifacts are attached.
